skill_name: Describe the thermal structure of Jupiter's atmosphere.
workflow: Jupiter's atmosphere is divided into five layers, with temperatures descending from an average of about 250 degrees Celsius at the top of the troposphere, to below -150 degrees Celsius at about 50 km deep. From about 50 km down to the surface, temperatures drop rapidly to around -80 degrees Celsius. Above the troposphere is an inversion layer that is at a surprisingly high temperature of around -30 degrees Celsius.
